subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Which Microsoft Teams attachment repair path should own this issue: the broader channel fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738, the config-gated group-chat fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096, or a combined/narrowed follow-up?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but two open closing pull requests make the remaining blocker a maintainer choice about fallback scope and operator-facing config rather than a missing repair candidate.

options.title: Land the broader channel fix
options.body: Use the proof-positive plugin-owned channel repair as the canonical fix, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Narrow the config-gated PR
options.body: Keep the new config surface limited to group-chat behavior and leave channel Graph URL repairs to the broader candidate.

options.title: Combine the approaches
options.body: Ask for one PR that includes the channel URL repairs plus an explicit maintainer-approved fallback/config policy.

recommendation.title: Land the broader channel fix
recommendation.body: Use the proof-positive plugin-owned channel repair as the canonical fix, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to this handle for Microsoft Teams plugin-boundary and config-surface product routing, which is the unresolved decision here.
